validation_scope: Exact archived inputs, source-task parsing, token timelines, full-vocabulary sham fingerprints, prefill BF16 geometry, and selected-payload receipts. Task/render/timeline and admission helpers are shared with frozen implementations. Decode geometry has scalar consistency checks, not independent residual-vector reconstruction. Full-cap engineering tested one C+ row; this S+ all-row screen additionally requires observed engagement and same-source prepatch identity. Arm groups use separate workers; matched software/GPU metadata and prepatch equality do not eliminate every possible hardware interaction. Receipt comparisons are selection-conditioned.
